name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: keep pasted secrets out of the transcript, see what a session has in context, let a session drive itself toward a goal, and equip a loadout of skills, MCP servers and instructions per project.

plugins.name: secret-keeper
plugins.description: Hides the secrets you paste before Claude or the transcript sees them, stores them per project in the macOS Keychain, and exports them to Bash as environment variables. Optional PII hiding.

plugins.name: context-compass
plugins.description: What a Claude Code session has in context: budget, files and how much of each was read, stale files, skills, helper agents, and what compaction summarised.

plugins.name: autopilot
plugins.description: Drives your Claude Code sessions on its own: asks you pointed questions first when a prompt leaves the goal, constraints or check unclear, rewrites the prompts you type, decides permission asks and Claude's questions from the whole conversation, and after each turn sends the practical next step (fix, verify, commit, push, open the PR) until only you can decide what is left.

plugins.name: loadouts
plugins.description: Requip for Claude Code: named loadouts of skills, MCP servers and instructions, one equipped per project from the /loadout picker or by Claude itself, the rest switched off. Switching never needs a restart.
